India Condemns Embassy Vandalism in Slovenia

The Indian government condemned the vandalism of its embassy in Slovenia. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that diplomatic premises are inviolable. The MEA called for action against 'anti-India' elements and demanded accountability. The incident involved the defacement of the Indian mission in Slovenia. The government reiterated its stand on the issue, strongly condemning it.
